needs_pass2_reason: earlier-run CSVs were unverified; this run checked every cell of all three tables against 300 dpi page images and found them correct, but the text layer is a poor OCR (it had a wrong minus value at Table I row 303.14), and a blind second pass is still advised
experimental_method: Benson-Krause type high-precision gas-solubility apparatus: degassed water equilibrated with methane, ethane or oxygen in a thermostatted cell; gas amounts determined from p-V-T of dry gas; Henry's constant derived per run with virial-equation corrections.
uncertainties_stated: Estimated uncertainty of H2,1 less than +-0.06% (text); average percent deviation from smoothing equations 0.056% (CH4) and 0.078% (C2H6); about 0.1% mean offset from Benson-Krause for O2 (ours lower).

Table I: text layer gives -0.24 for the 303.14 K deviation; the image shows -0.04 (the 4 is crossed by a smudge); -0.04 is consistent with 4.7521 vs 4.7539.
